changed_behaviour: Response DTO of Altinn permissions gains a new adressesperreTilganger list of company numbers.
rationale: No contract; endpoint not identifiable from the DTO alone.

changed_behaviour: PATCH project now renames a project using new name and office query parameters instead of updating from a request-body Project.
rationale: Swagger config has no projects paths; operation undocumented.

changed_behaviour: After passkey login with two-factor, the handler now returns after the 2FA response instead of also running the 1FA response (double response).
rationale: Passkey POST documented with 200/403 only; the duplicate-response fix is not described.

changed_behaviour: Launch-finished notifications are skipped for manual launches; project names are trimmed and rejected if too short after trimming on create and patch.
CORS now also allows origins starting with http://127.0.0.1 (CORS headers set), like localhost.
rationale: Cross-cutting filter on all routes; swagger has no CORS description.

changed_behaviour: Policy conditions gain EXPRESSION subject, violationType field, longer value, and expression validation returning 400 with celErrors or missing violation type.
Settings key server.footer.links renamed to server.sidebar.links in update-settings request enum.
Attachment preview rendering refactored; preview returned even if cache read or write fails, otherwise same output.
rationale: Mostly internal refactor; swagger has no preview endpoint for attachments found.

changed_behaviour: Fee charges are now added to chargesDueAtTimeOfDisbursement in the disbursement period of the loan schedule instead of being ignored.
rationale: No contract; operation inferred from schedule model.

changed_behaviour: Review creation with a missing product now returns 404 instead of 400; type-mismatch and unreadable-body errors now return framework 400 instead of 500; handlers ordered.
rationale: POST documents 200/400/401/500 only; no 404 for unknown product.

changed_behaviour: New endpoint GET /wallet/jarm/{requestId}/jwks.json returns the JARM ephemeral JWKS; client metadata jwks reference now points to it.
Password validation failures (min length, too similar to identifier, too many breaches) now return structured validation messages with message IDs.
rationale: Spec does not describe password policy messages or IDs.

changed_behaviour: Aggregate source info response gains annotationSourcesInfo list of source version entries.
Synchronization added around permission computation in Entra ID credential; no HTTP-visible change except fixing race on missing parent group permissions.
rationale: Thread-safety fix; contract does not describe it.

changed_behaviour: Contract sync now skips partner entitlements with null purchase data and tolerates null Azure contracts instead of failing.
rationale: Sync op documented with generic success; malformed-entitlement handling unstated.
